COMPONENT_GRAPH.cli: artifactguard evaluate/verify-permit load deterministic inputs, preserve exit codes, and delegate to one runtime boundary.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.decision_journal: authoritative checksummed ALLOW/DENY journal is durable before success; projection follows journal.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.evidence_gateway: exact digest+policy+scanner-revision cache/scanner evidence is selected with explicit fail-closed unavailable/stale/malformed handling.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.exception_evaluator: exceptions run after prerequisite gates and can waive only exact-scope vulnerability-threshold denials.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.normalization: manager profiles normalize package/container/dependency acquisitions into canonical request identity.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.permit_service: HMAC-style keyed permits bind request, instance, digest, policy and expiry; stateful verification consumes them durably once.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.policy_snapshot: one validated versioned policy snapshot exposes source, digest, severity, cache, permit and scanner requirements.
COMPONENT_GRAPH.state_coordinator: locking, atomic replacement, replay state, cache durability, journal recovery and projections share the caller-owned state root.

outputs.DATA_VOLUME_PLAN: No bulk business-record seed is applicable; this configuration/state-backed host policy runtime scales through reachable logic and organically growing cache/journal/replay state.

ENTRYPOINTS.name: artifactguard evaluate
ENTRYPOINTS.reachability: CLI -> normalize -> policy -> source/digest -> evidence/cache -> vulnerability/exception -> permit -> durable decision; DENY 42, operational 2.

ENTRYPOINTS.name: artifactguard verify-permit
ENTRYPOINTS.reachability: CLI -> canonical permit/request/policy -> keyed scope/expiry verification -> optional locked replay consumption; invalid 43.

ENTRYPOINTS.name: Go build/test
ENTRYPOINTS.reachability: go test ./... and go build ./cmd/artifactguard cover the production packages used by the CLI.

PRODUCTION_CHARACTERISTICS: one real Go CLI reaches all runtime responsibilities
outputs.SCALE_FIT: VERY_HIGH: the strict-scale footprint is production-reachable and causally coupled rather than generated or duplicated padding.

SOLVER_VISIBLE_DOC_PLAN.purpose: normalization, trust/digest, evidence/cache, exception and permit semantics
operator use, restart/concurrency, failure and recovery behavior
legitimate symptoms only, without private topology/test mappings

outputs.STATE_MODEL: Caller-owned state root contains exact-keyed cache, authoritative append-only decision journal, derived latest-decision projection, and durable permit-consumption replay state. Journal/replay are source-of-truth; derived projections are rebuilt/reconciled. Locks plus temp+fsync+rename+directory-fsync provide atomic durable publication and restart-safe recovery.
